faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Podacium's platform, pricing, and features.

0.question: What is Podacium and how does it work?
0.answer: Podacium is an all-in-one platform combining online education, a freelance marketplace, and business intelligence tools. Learners take courses and earn certificates, freelancers find projects and get paid securely, and businesses analyze data and discover talent — all in one ecosystem.

1.question: How does the three-pillar platform work?
1.answer: Podacium has three integrated pillars: Learn (online courses with verified certificates), Hub (freelance marketplace with PodaPoints feature payments), and BI (business intelligence dashboards and data analytics). Progress and skills flow across pillars, so learning achievements strengthen your freelancer profile, and BI insights inform business decisions.

2.question: Is Podacium available in Arabic, French, and English?
2.answer: Yes. The entire platform is available in English, French, and Arabic. You can switch languages at any time, and all course content, platform UI, and support are localized for each language.

3.question: Who can benefit from Podacium?
3.answer: Students and professionals looking to upskill, freelancers seeking projects and clients, businesses needing talent and data analytics, and organizations wanting to track team development — all find value on Podacium.

4.question: Do I need technical skills to get started?
4.answer: Not at all. Podacium is designed for all skill levels. Beginners can start with foundational courses, and personalized recommendations help you find the right path based on your goals and current experience.

5.question: How does the recommendation system work?
5.answer: The system analyzes your learning history, career goals, and platform activity to recommend personalized courses, projects, and BI tools. Recommendations improve over time as you interact with more content, delivering increasingly relevant suggestions for your growth.

6.question: Can I use Podacium on mobile devices?
6.answer: Yes. Podacium is fully responsive and works on all devices including smartphones and tablets. You can take courses, browse freelance projects, and view BI dashboards from any device. A dedicated mobile app is also in development for an enhanced on-the-go experience.

0.question: How much does Podacium cost?
0.answer: Podacium offers free basic access with options to upgrade. Course pricing starts from 500 DZD, Learn subscriptions from 1,500 DZD/month, and BI Pro from 3,000 DZD/month. The Freelance Hub uses PodaPoints for feature purchases with no project commissions. Annual plans save up to 25%.

1.question: What payment methods do you accept?
1.answer: We accept all major Algerian bank cards (CIB/Dahabia), international credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), and mobile payment solutions. Enterprise clients can also pay by bank transfer or invoice.

2.question: Is there a free trial?
2.answer: Yes. New users get a 14-day free trial with full access to all Pro features across Learn, Hub, and BI. No credit card is required, and you can cancel anytime during the trial period at no cost.

3.question: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
3.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. Monthly plans change immediately, and annual plans receive prorated refunds. There are no long-term commitments.

4.question: Do you offer regional pricing for Algeria and MENA countries?
4.answer: Yes. Podacium offers region-specific pricing in Algerian Dinar (DZD) with rates designed to be accessible for the MENA market. We accept local payment methods including CIB and Dahabia cards, and offer annual plans that save up to 25% compared to monthly billing.

0.question: How does progress tracking work across devices?
0.answer: Your progress syncs automatically in real time across all your devices. Start a course on your laptop, continue on your phone, and pick up where you left off — your video position, quiz scores, and completed lessons are always up to date.

1.question: Can I earn verified certificates?
1.answer: Yes. Upon completing a course or learning path, you receive a verified certificate that can be shared on LinkedIn, added to your portfolio, or used to strengthen your freelancer profile on Podacium Hub.

2.question: How secure is my data on Podacium?
2.answer: We apply enterprise-grade security: end-to-end encryption in transit and at rest, regular security audits, and strict access controls. Your personal information, project data, and payment details are protected at all times.

3.question: Can I export my data?
3.answer: Yes. You can export your course progress, certificates, BI dashboards, and reports as CSV, PDF, or PNG. Dataset downloads are available in CSV, Excel, and JSON formats.

4.question: How does the freelance marketplace payment system work?
4.answer: Podacium uses a feature-based pricing model with PodaPoints. Instead of commissions, you purchase features like project posts (200 PodaPoints) or featured listings (500 PodaPoints). There are no platform commissions on your earnings — you only pay for the services you actively use.

5.question: Does Podacium offer API access for integration with other tools?
5.answer: Yes. Podacium provides a RESTful API for developers and businesses who want to integrate platform features into their existing workflows. API access is available on paid plans and includes comprehensive documentation, SDK examples, and dedicated support for enterprise integrations.

6.question: How does Podacium ensure platform security and data protection?
6.answer: Security is foundational at Podacium. We employ end-to-end encryption for all data in transit and at rest, conduct regular third-party security audits, and enforce strict access controls. Our infrastructure is hosted in secure data centers with 24/7 monitoring and automated threat detection.

0.question: How do I create an account?
0.answer: Click 'Get Started' and sign up with your email address or Google account. Choose your role (Learner, Freelancer, or Business) and complete your profile. The whole process takes under two minutes, and basic access is free.

1.question: How do I reset my password?
1.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email address, and we will send you a secure reset link. The link expires after one hour for security. If you do not receive the email, check your spam folder.

2.question: Can I have multiple roles on the same account?
2.answer: Yes. You can be a learner taking courses, a freelancer bidding on projects, and a business owner hiring talent — all from the same account. Your dashboard adapts to show the tools relevant to each role.

3.question: How do I contact support?
3.answer: You can reach our support team via the live chat widget on any page, email us at support@podacium.com, or visit the Help Center. Enterprise clients get dedicated account managers with priority response times.

4.question: How do I permanently delete my account and data?
4.answer: You can request account deletion from your Settings page under Privacy. Once confirmed, your personal data, course progress, and account information will be permanently erased within 30 days. Projects and contracts you are actively engaged in must be completed or transferred before deletion.

5.question: Does Podacium support two-factor authentication (2FA)?
5.answer: Yes. Podacium supports two-factor authentication via authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS codes. Enabling 2FA adds an extra layer of security to your account and is highly recommended for freelancers and business users handling sensitive data.
